A♥.name: ACE OF HEARTS
A♥.under: You flood the room with feeling before anyone has agreed to hold it. Intensity stands in for being known.
A♥.sweet_spot: You start real connection on purpose: you say what you feel and leave room for the other person to answer.
A♥.over: You use feeling as leverage. The cost is people manage your mood instead of meeting you.

2♥.name: 2 OF HEARTS
2♥.under: You change shape to keep the peace. After a while you cannot tell which preference was actually yours.
2♥.sweet_spot: You keep your needs and theirs in the same conversation, and you let disagreement stay on the table.
2♥.over: You take responsibility for other people's moods. The cost is you disappear, then resent the people you were managing.

3♥.name: 3 OF HEARTS
3♥.under: You keep a spare connection warm so no single person can pin you down. Variety protects you from being chosen.
3♥.sweet_spot: You let love have range without using newness as an exit from the one that is already here.
3♥.over: You arrive all-in, then find a fatal flaw the moment the connection asks you to stay.

4♥.name: 4 OF HEARTS
4♥.under: You treat control as safety. Everyone gets a role; nothing unscripted is allowed in.
4♥.sweet_spot: You build a home people can count on, and you leave enough air for feeling to move.
4♥.over: You call real emotion messy and shut it down. The house is orderly. Nobody actually lives there.

5♥.name: 5 OF HEARTS
5♥.under: You leave when a connection starts asking you to stay in one place. Variety looks like freedom; it can also be how you avoid being known.
5♥.sweet_spot: You let love change shape without using motion as a way out of being seen.
5♥.over: You call it freedom when you will not stay long enough for the relationship to cost you anything.

6♥.name: 6 OF HEARTS
6♥.under: You keep the peace by not saying what you need. The quiet does not stay quiet; it turns into resentment.
6♥.sweet_spot: You care for people without disappearing. Help comes from a full plate, not an empty one.
6♥.over: You play the nice one. Conflict gets swallowed. The people you protect never find out what you actually wanted.

7♥.name: 7 OF HEARTS
7♥.under: You step back from feeling and call it discernment. Distance keeps you safe and also keeps you alone.
7♥.sweet_spot: You look at love clearly without using analysis as a way not to feel it.
7♥.over: You stay in your head and call it honesty. The body of the relationship never gets a vote.

8♥.name: 8 OF HEARTS
8♥.under: You shut feeling down and lead with logic. Power stays clean because nothing tender is allowed near it.
8♥.sweet_spot: You hold the emotional room without taking it over. People know where they stand.
8♥.over: You decide how other people are allowed to feel. Strength becomes possession.

9♥.name: 9 OF HEARTS
9♥.under: You collapse into helping and then resent the people you are carrying. The ideal was cleaner than the work.
9♥.sweet_spot: You stay kind without picking up what is not yours.
9♥.over: You save people and skip yourself. Burnout wears the costume of care.

10♥.name: 10 OF HEARTS
10♥.under: You carry the family's feeling for them. Belonging starts to mean you do not get to put anything down.
10♥.sweet_spot: You make room for a lot of people and still keep a self inside the room.
10♥.over: Everyone's mood becomes your job. Care turns into a system of quiet obligation.

J♥.name: JACK OF HEARTS
J♥.under: You fall for the story of the person instead of the person. Fantasy is safer than the slow work of knowing someone.
J♥.sweet_spot: You bring a fresh read on love without leaving the room when it gets ordinary.
J♥.over: The narrative outruns the relationship. It collapses the first time reality asks for depth.

Q♥.name: QUEEN OF HEARTS
Q♥.under: You read the room first and yourself last. Other people's weather decides whether your needs get airtime.
Q♥.sweet_spot: You take care of people from presence, not from scanning for what they might need next.
Q♥.over: Care becomes control. Love starts to look like a debt they did not agree to.

K♥.name: KING OF HEARTS
K♥.under: You rule the emotional field from a safe distance. Authority stays intact because no one can reach you.
K♥.sweet_spot: You hold emotional authority without hiding behind it.
K♥.over: You decide the feeling climate. People comply. They stop telling you the truth.

A♣.name: ACE OF CLUBS
A♣.under: You think past the starting line. Thoroughness becomes a way not to begin.
A♣.sweet_spot: You start a new idea while it is still usable, and you let it meet the world unfinished.
A♣.over: You are sure you are right before anyone else has spoken. New thought becomes a closed case.

2♣.name: 2 OF CLUBS
2♣.under: You keep the debate open so you never have to pick. Indecision wears the mask of fairness.
2♣.sweet_spot: You think with someone else and still leave the conversation with a position of your own.
2♣.over: You need to win the argument. The other mind stops being a partner and becomes an opponent.

3♣.name: 3 OF CLUBS
3♣.under: You open more projects than you finish. Exploration never has to survive contact with an ending.
3♣.sweet_spot: You move an idea across more than one channel without abandoning the one that needs depth.
3♣.over: You scatter attention and call it range. Nothing sits still long enough to get good.

4♣.name: 4 OF CLUBS
4♣.under: You use a framework to keep uncertainty out. The system is safer than the question.
4♣.sweet_spot: You put knowledge into an order other people can actually use.
4♣.over: You defend the system after it stops fitting. Being right outranks being current.

5♣.name: 5 OF CLUBS
5♣.under: You think about the change instead of making it. Analysis does the job of motion.
5♣.sweet_spot: You pressure-test an idea in public and let the better one win.
5♣.over: You argue to prove you are sharper. Conflict becomes the point.

6♣.name: 6 OF CLUBS
6♣.under: You give the knowledge away and keep your own authority quiet. Teaching becomes self-erasure.
6♣.sweet_spot: You pass on what you know without disappearing behind the lesson.
6♣.over: You need to be the one who knows. Other people get cast as students whether they asked or not.

7♣.name: 7 OF CLUBS
7♣.under: Skepticism turns into isolation. Nothing is solid enough to act on, so you stay out.
7♣.sweet_spot: You take a claim apart until the usable piece is left, then you use it.
7♣.over: You complicate the problem past the point of action. Complexity protects you from shipping.

8♣.name: 8 OF CLUBS
8♣.under: You keep the sharp mind in reserve. Leadership would make the thinking visible, so you decline it.
8♣.sweet_spot: You run a knowledge system other people can follow, and you stand behind the call.
8♣.over: You use intellect to shut people down. Being the smartest person in the room becomes the whole job.

9♣.name: 9 OF CLUBS
9♣.under: You hold an old map after the terrain has changed. Fatigue looks like loyalty to the idea.
9♣.sweet_spot: You let a used-up framework go and keep the part that still works.
9♣.over: You preach the map. Other viewpoints are treated as incomplete versions of yours.

10♣.name: 10 OF CLUBS
10♣.under: You stockpile what you know and stop putting it to work. Mastery sits unused.
10♣.sweet_spot: You carry a finished body of knowledge and keep teaching from it.
10♣.over: You control who gets the information. Authority depends on other people staying one step behind.

J♣.name: JACK OF CLUBS
J♣.under: The idea comes out half-built. Speed stands in for a check against reality.
J♣.sweet_spot: You bring a new angle and you let someone pressure-test it before it ships.
J♣.over: You pitch before you have checked whether it can live. Excitement outruns the work.

Q♣.name: QUEEN OF CLUBS
Q♣.under: You know more than you say. Deference keeps the room comfortable and keeps your mind hidden.
Q♣.sweet_spot: You teach from what you actually know, without making people earn the right to hear it.
Q♣.over: You decide when others are ready. Knowledge becomes a gate you keep.

K♣.name: KING OF CLUBS
K♣.under: You withhold the call and still believe you already know. Authority hides instead of working.
K♣.sweet_spot: You make the intellectual call in the open and you can revise it.
K♣.over: Dissent is treated as error. The room learns to agree with you instead of thinking.

A♦.name: ACE OF DIAMONDS
A♦.under: You cling to what you have and rehearse losing it. Security work never quite starts.
A♦.sweet_spot: You start a resource in motion because you trust you can make and keep value.
A♦.over: You collect to prove you are worth something. Other people start to look like competition.

2♦.name: 2 OF DIAMONDS
2♦.under: You give the better end of the deal so no one can call you greedy. The short end becomes a habit, then a grudge.
2♦.sweet_spot: You name the exchange out loud and keep it fair for both sides.
2♦.over: You steer the money so you stay in control of the relationship.

3♦.name: 3 OF DIAMONDS
3♦.under: You open too many income paths and stabilize none. Options replace a working floor.
3♦.sweet_spot: You keep more than one path alive without letting any of them stay imaginary.
3♦.over: You chase the next dollar so hard the current one never settles.

4♦.name: 4 OF DIAMONDS
4♦.under: You hold money as a wall against chaos. The wall gets thicker than the life it was supposed to protect.
4♦.sweet_spot: You build a floor that lasts and still let money move when the work requires it.
4♦.over: You will not release cash even when keeping it costs more than spending it.

5♦.name: 5 OF DIAMONDS
5♦.under: Fear of loss freezes the next move. The safe choice is the one that does not happen.
5♦.sweet_spot: You adjust the resource plan when the ground moves, without pretending nothing changed.
5♦.over: You spend to feel motion. Chaos gets billed as flexibility.

6♦.name: 6 OF DIAMONDS
6♦.under: You over-give and do not say what you need back. Generosity becomes a way to stay unpaid.
6♦.sweet_spot: You move resources toward other people without erasing your own claim.
6♦.over: Gifts come with a string. Help becomes a way to keep someone obligated.

7♦.name: 7 OF DIAMONDS
7♦.under: You watch for lack even when the numbers do not support it. Caution stops being useful and starts running the day.
7♦.sweet_spot: You look at worth without reducing it to the account balance.
7♦.over: You treat every surplus as temporary. Scarcity stays in charge after the evidence has changed.

8♦.name: 8 OF DIAMONDS
8♦.under: You step back from resource leadership. Power looks dangerous, so you leave it on the table.
8♦.sweet_spot: You run the money system in the open and you can explain the call.
8♦.over: You use money to keep people in line. The ledger becomes a hierarchy.

9♦.name: 9 OF DIAMONDS
9♦.under: You keep giving after you are empty. Receiving feels like a failure of character.
9♦.sweet_spot: You give in a way you can sustain, and you let someone give back.
9♦.over: You stay the generous one past the point of honesty. Resentment does the work the boundary should have done.

10♦.name: 10 OF DIAMONDS
10♦.under: You carry other people's bills and call it family. Their floor becomes your ceiling.
10♦.sweet_spot: You build enough and keep it structured so it actually holds.
10♦.over: People start to look like instruments. The win is counted; the relationship is not.

J♦.name: JACK OF DIAMONDS
J♦.under: You get excited about the next way to make money and do not stay for the unglamorous middle.
J♦.sweet_spot: You try a new approach to value and you finish enough of it to know if it works.
J♦.over: You promise a return you have not built. The pitch outruns the product.

Q♦.name: QUEEN OF DIAMONDS
Q♦.under: You have resources and still manage them as if loss is already scheduled. Control stands in for trust.
Q♦.sweet_spot: You protect what you have without making every dollar a referendum on safety.
Q♦.over: Money becomes the condition for closeness. People feel the price of disappointing you.

K♦.name: KING OF DIAMONDS
K♦.under: You hold the resources and decline the public call. Power unused still shapes the room.
K♦.sweet_spot: You run the system and you can show your work.
K♦.over: Other people's labor exists to grow your position. Stewardship drops out of the job description.

A♠.name: ACE OF SPADES
A♠.under: You leave the hard fact unnamed. The story stays kinder than the situation.
A♠.sweet_spot: You say the true thing early, before it has to become a crisis to be heard.
A♠.over: You call it honesty when you use the fact as a blade.

2♠.name: 2 OF SPADES
2♠.under: You research both sides until the decision window closes. Thoroughness is how you avoid choosing.
2♠.sweet_spot: You hold two pressures at once and still make a call that can live in the world.
2♠.over: You refuse the choice so hard that other people start fighting it for you.

3♠.name: 3 OF SPADES
3♠.under: Grief takes the whole field. Nothing else gets to move until the feeling is finished, and it is not finishing.
3♠.sweet_spot: You stay with the hard feeling long enough to learn it, then you let the day continue.
3♠.over: Pain becomes the argument. Other people are drafted into a story they did not cause.

4♠.name: 4 OF SPADES
4♠.under: You brace against change and call it stability. The structure is there to keep the new thing out.
4♠.sweet_spot: You build enough container that change can happen without the floor disappearing.
4♠.over: Nothing gets in. The defense outlasts the threat.

5♠.name: 5 OF SPADES
5♠.under: You freeze when the fight starts and treat the circumstance as the whole cause.
5♠.sweet_spot: You stay in the hard stretch long enough to get better at it.
5♠.over: You keep conflict close because it proves you can survive. Calm starts to feel like a loss.

6♠.name: 6 OF SPADES
6♠.under: You tend other people's damage and skip your own. Service is how you avoid the wound.
6♠.sweet_spot: You use what you have already walked through without requiring anyone else to be in pain for it to count.
6♠.over: You need someone to be struggling so your help has a job. Care starts to depend on their not-being-well.

7♠.name: 7 OF SPADES
7♠.under: You assume the worst reading and stop looking for the usable one.
7♠.sweet_spot: You study the hard pattern until you can name it, then you do the next honest thing.
7♠.over: Difficulty becomes the worldview. Every clean fact gets filed as a setup.

8♠.name: 8 OF SPADES
8♠.under: You step off the hook and resent the people who picked it up. Power unused still costs you.
8♠.sweet_spot: You take the hard lead and you stay with the work after the call is made.
8♠.over: You run the room through force of mind. People comply. They do not bring you their real information.

9♠.name: 9 OF SPADES
9♠.under: You will not close the cycle. The ending sits on the desk because finishing would mean starting without it.
9♠.sweet_spot: You complete the hard stretch and put the lesson down.
9♠.over: You force the ending before the work is done. Closure becomes a way not to stay.

10♠.name: 10 OF SPADES
10♠.under: You pick up everyone's hard piece and call it duty. The load is heavier than the job required.
10♠.sweet_spot: You do the difficult curriculum in front of you without adding the ones that are not yours.
10♠.over: You raise the standard until no one, including you, can meet it. Relentlessness replaces judgment.

J♠.name: JACK OF SPADES
J♠.under: You say the true thing without staying for what it does to the room.
J♠.sweet_spot: You name what is actually happening and you remain after you have said it.
J♠.over: Honesty becomes a ranking system. People hear the cut before they hear the fact.

Q♠.name: QUEEN OF SPADES
Q♠.under: You know the true read and let someone else's version stand. Peace is purchased with your silence.
Q♠.sweet_spot: You tell the necessary truth at a volume the other person can use.
Q♠.over: You hold the fact back so you keep the advantage. Clarity becomes a private asset.

K♠.name: KING OF SPADES
K♠.under: You stay in the mind and out of the feeling. Command is easier when nothing in you can be reached.
K♠.sweet_spot: You make the hard call without pretending you have no interior.
K♠.over: Feeling is treated as a leak. People fall in line and stop bringing you anything human.
